svg.title: The pack at a glance
svg.desc: 79 skills in 6 specialties: Ship 13 (Orchestration & routing 6, Code review & CI 4, Apps: iOS & Android 3); Craft 11 (Design & copy 5, Creative assets 6); Get found 22 (Search & AI visibility 13, Content & audience 9); Demand channels 9 (Paid & outbound 4, Lifecycle messaging 2, Acquisition assets 3); Revenue & retention 12 (Money & funnel 7, Measure & operate 5); Strategy & rights 12 (Strategy & research 8, Creator toolkit 4).
svg.text: From first commit to paying customer.
Every specialty, every lane, every skill in the pack. Slugs shown without the suede- prefix.

g.text: Get the change built, reviewed, and merged.
Make the thing look and read like someone built it on purpose.
Be discoverable by search, by AI answers, and by an audience.
Reach people who have not heard of you yet.
Convert the attention, then keep what it earned.
Know the market you are in and own what you make.
